name: The Center for Avian & Exotic Medicine
region_note: Dedicated exotics day-practice (routine + sick visits, not 24/7):
notes:
562 Columbus Avenue, Manhattan, NY 10024 (212) 501-8750 - open 7 days 9am-7pm. NYC's only exclusively avian & exotic veterinary hospital (a calm, dog/cat-free environment). Treats birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, small mammals, small ruminants, and wildlife-as-pets (e.g. squirrels, pigeons); offers TeleVet for established patients. The natural complement to AMC's ER for non-emergency exotic care. (On Columbus Ave, near the Wild Bird Fund.)

The Center for Avian & Exotic Medicine (562 Columbus Ave; (212) 501-8750) - not free, but the dedicated exotics day-practice; ask about payment plans + wellness packages to spread cost.
